sample_unit: AI-generated consent forms (one per device), each rated by 5 dermatologists

links.outcome: Accuracy and completeness of AI-generated consent forms rated by dermatologists
links.effect: Quality varied by device: radiofrequency microneedling scored highest (2.75/3.0) and monopolar radiofrequency lowest (1.85). Some forms had incomplete or inaccurate content, so dermatologist oversight was judged essential.
links.quote: However, variability in completeness and occasional inaccuracies limit its standalone clinical utility.

screen.reason: The study empirically evaluates the quality and accuracy of ChatGPT-generated informed consent forms for dermatologic devices using dermatologist raters, without testing a specific organizational deployment practice or guardrail.
